definitions.explanation: Happening or doing something regularly but not constantly; from time to time.

examples.japanese: ちょくちょく⟦{会|あ}います→会う：00482_au⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ちょくちょく⟦{来|き}ます→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: I come to this shop frequently.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧ちょくちょく⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかって→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧くる。
examples.english: Lately I've been getting calls quite often.

notes:
ちょくちょく means "fairly often" or "from time to time" — more frequent than ⟦{時々|ときどき}→時々：00600_tokidoki⟧ but less constant than ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧.

FREQUENCY SCALE (approximate):
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧: always
- ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧: often
- ちょくちょく: fairly often (casual)
- ⟦{時々|ときどき}→時々：00600_tokidoki⟧: sometimes
- ⟦たまに→たまに：01276_tamani⟧: occasionally
- めった⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧～⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: rarely

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧: often (neutral register, broader usage)
- {度々|たびたび}: frequently (more formal)
- ⟦しばしば→しばしば：02365_shibashiba⟧: often (literary/written)
- ⟦{頻繁|ひんぱん}→頻繁：08631_hinpan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: frequently (formal)

REGISTER:
Casual/colloquial. Not appropriate for formal writing or speeches. Use ⟦{頻繁|ひんぱん}→頻繁：08631_hinpan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or {度々|たびたび} in formal contexts.
